top_signals.title: India Court Drops Protest Cases, Youth Group Cancels March
top_signals.summary: India’s top court ordered criminal cases dropped against students who took part in mass protests led by the Cockroach Janta Party in July, prompting the group to call off a planned march later this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
